title: AC1024 R24 TABLESTYLE bounded DXF output

independentProjection.scope: Corroborates the R24 marker grammar, ID-4 Table style with no grid records, three standard cell styles, color projection, margins, text heights and border masks. This peer projection does not establish source semantics or consumer acceptance.

implementation.summary: Retain the observed R24 prefix values in DRW_TableStyle and admit only the witnessed 0/8/101/null-handle prefix and Standard Table/title/header/data model. Emit bounded rich TABLEFORMAT, CONTENTFORMAT, CELLMARGIN, GRIDFORMAT and CELLSTYLE marker spans; map the three source text-style handles to the emitted DXF STYLE identity. The R24 Table style has no grid records; each of its three standard cell styles has six borders.
implementation.colorProjection: Map source CMC C8/kNone to DXF group 62 value 257 and source C1/byBlock to 0, matching the same-input LibreDWG projection. No broader color semantic claim is made.
implementation.failureAndRetry: The generated selector changes the unknown prefix from 8 to 9 and then uses unresolved text-style handle 0x999; each export refuses while preserving the existing destination. It restores prefix 8, replaces the bad reference with source handle 0x560, and succeeds through the same adapter.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The AC1024 model is authored in memory. ASCII/Binary DXF outputs are temporary and removed. The physical source remains outside the repository; no investigation fixtures were added.

proof.readback: ASCII and Binary output reimport as one TABLE entity plus one raw TABLESTYLE record. The test checks the table-to-style handle edge, exact four CELLSTYLE identities, rich marker counts/order, margins, text heights, C8/C1 group-62 values, all 18 standard-style border masks, and three remapped group-340 text-style references. Rich R24 nested styles remain raw-only on DXF import; no typed nested readback claim is made.

physicalDiagnostic.result: Expected failure after progress: the physical partial run advances beyond TABLESTYLE and stops at `DXF OBJECTS output inspection failed: MATERIAL`. Exit code 1; no output DXF was published.

limits: This proves one bounded AC1024 R24 TABLESTYLE serializer profile and advances one physical partial conversion; it does not close the physical document graph.
The physical run is partial-read diagnostic only. Strict complete-export admission remains blocked by source closure and opaque callback views not retained for output.
The rich R24 DXF reader currently retains nested marker groups raw-only; typed nested-style semantics remain open.
No native TABLE rendering, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD acceptance, ABI compatibility, or broader DWG/DXF support is qualified.
